Static initializer folded: the four ObjKeyModelFile handles (files 0x44d, 0x49c, 0x49d, 0x49e), the four ObjKeyAnimationFilePtr handles (files 0x44e, 0x44f, 0x450, 0x451), their destructor-registration nodes, the eight PMF descriptors and the ObjKeyStateTable make mwcc emit __sinit_daObjKey_c.cpp itself (0x220, raw-byte-identical to retail __sinit_ov089_021328d4 with the same relocation sites); the handwritten src/unnamed/ov089/__sinit_ov089_021328d4.c is retired. mwcc numbers the descriptors @528-@542 per TU and the fleet already defines those names, so defined_symbol_renames carries them as @700-@710/@724/@726. The offset vector at 0x02132ca4 is a plain ObjKeyVec3 triple: a Vector3 static would register a destructor the retail initializer never calls. This fold does NOT license the .rodata file tables (0x02132880..0x021328d4), the b40 Vector3, the RTTI chain, the two g_profile rows or the vtable.

The vtable this TU is the key function for. ROM home ov089:0x02132ba8 is the address point; verify reports size=0x84 (the two-word RTTI prologue plus 31 slots). D1 and the two folded factories (`return new daObjKey_c()`) store this vptr; production isolation rebinds those stores to the ROM home and deadstrips the copy.

Homeless. One out-of-line destructor under `#pragma defer_codegen off` emits D1, D0 and D2 in that order, but the cartridge has only D1 (0x02130f00, 0x50) and D0 (0x02130f50, 0x64). StateDrop, Behavior and InitResources declare local Vector3s, so this TU odr-uses inline ~Vector3. The cartridge's copy lives at arm9:0x020072c0, owned by src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp; rombuild compares this object copy against those cartridge bytes before dropping it.
